data.exact_reserve_text: There were no issues arising from our closed years being 2007 to 2013 and all of these years combined produced a surplus which contributed both to the calendar year result and the closing 2014 account result. At thirty-six months the account has produced a profit of $1.7 million (GBP 1.4 million) which equates to 2.3% of stamp. This compares to the previous forecast range provided to Lloyd's at 30th September 2016 of -5% to +5%. The following amounts will be transferred to member's personal reserve funds on 11 April 2017: 2014 Year of Account US$1,702,115.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a profit of $1.7 million for the 2014 Year of Account, which is being transferred to members, indicating a release of reserves for that year. Additionally, the closed years from 2007 to 2013 collectively produced an unquantified surplus, also contributing to a release of prior year reserves. No specific events or adverse developments were mentioned for prior years.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is quantified only for the 2014 Year of Account; the surplus for 2007-2013 is not quantified. Gross premiums written per underwriting year are not available to calculate prior year development from the loss ratio triangle.
